label: Вести
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for вести (to lead, guide, conduct).

missions.phrase: Я веду детей в школу каждое утро.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. Вести is imperfective with the irregular present stem вед-, so the 1sg is 'веду' with the -у ending. It is the unidirectional verb of the водить pair.
Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Ведёшь' shows the stressed -ёшь ending on stem вед-. As a unidirectional imperfective it names one ongoing act of leading in a single direction.

missions.phrase: Эта дорога ведёт прямо к реке.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Ведёт' is the она-form ending in -ёт on вед-. Here it has the common figurative sense of a road leading somewhere, an ongoing fixed direction.

missions.phrase: Мы ведём долгий разговор о политике.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Ведём' carries the -ём ending on вед-. The idiom 'вести разговор' means to carry on a conversation, an ongoing imperfective activity.
Strategic focus: Second-person plural or polite present. 'Ведёте' trains the respectful вы-form with -ёте on вед-. 'Вести машину' is the fixed phrase for driving a car as an ongoing process.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Ведут' closes the present ladder with the -ут ending on вед-. This well-known saying shows the figurative leading sense in the plural.

missions.phrase: Он вёл группу через тёмный лес.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. The past of вести is irregular: the masculine form is 'вёл' with no -л suffix visible after the stem. It reports an ongoing act of leading in the past.
Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Вела' shows the feminine past built on the вёл stem with -а and the ё shifting to е when unstressed. 'Вести урок' means to conduct a lesson.

missions.phrase: Проводники вели туристов по горной тропе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Вели' is the plural past ending in -и, completing the past forms. The imperfective stresses the ongoing process of guiding the tourists along the trail.
Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Веди' is the informal command form on stem вед-. The reflexive idiom 'вести себя' means to behave, so this orders one person to behave properly.
